G5500.def:
χειρο-τονέω, -ῶ
(χείρ, τείνω) 
__1. to vote by stretching out the hand in the Athenian ἐκκλησία (Luc., Plut.). 
__2. to appoint: 
__(a) by vote, 2 Corinthiens 8:19 
__(b) without vote, Actes 14:23 (see Rackham, in l) (cf. προχειροτονέω).†

G5501.def:
χείρων, -ον, compar. of κακός 
[in LXX: 1 Rois 17:43 B, Wis.15:18 17:6, 3Ma.5:20 * ;] 
worse: Matthieu 9:16 12:45 27:64, Marc 2:21, Luc 11:26, Jean 5:14, 1 Timothée 5:8, Hébreux 10:29, 2 Pierre 2:20; εἰς (ἐπὶ) τὸ χεῖρον, Marc 5:26, 2 Timothée 3:13.†

G5502.def:
Χερουβείν (Rec. -βίμ), τά (Heb. כְּרוּב), 
Cherubim: Hébreux 9:6 (cf. Exode 25:17 (18), al.; see DB, i, 377 ff.).†

G5503.def:
χήρα, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for אַלְמָנָה ;] 
a widow: Matthieu 23:13 (Rec., R, mg.), Marc 12:40-43, Luc 2:37 4:25 7:12 18:3, 5 20:47 21:2-3, Actes 6:1 9:39, 41, 1 Corinthiens 7:8, 1 Timothée 5:3-5 5:11 5:16, Jacques 1:27; γυνὴ χ., Luc 4:26; of one of an ordo viduarum (see CGT, in l), 1 Timothée 5:9; metaphorically, of a city forsaken, Apocalypse 18:7.†

G5504.def:
ἐχθές
(Rec. χθές), adv., [in LXX for תְּמוֹל, etc. ;] 
yesterday: Jean 4:52, Actes 7:28, Hébreux 13:8 (on the form, see Rutherford, NPhr., 370 f.).†
ἐχθές, 
adverb ={χθές}, yesterday, ( 5th-6th c.BC: Aristophanes Comicus “Nubes” 175, “Th.” 616, etc.; ἀπ᾽ ἐ. “Anthologia Graeca” 11.35 (1st c.BC: Philodemus Gadarensis Epigrammaticus); μέσφα τό γ᾽ ἐ. 3rd c.BC: Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus 2.144 ); οὐ γάρ τι νῦν γε κἀ. today or yesterday, ( 5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Antigone” 456; οὐκ ἐ. οὐδὲ πρῴην 5th c.BC: Antipho Orator “fragment” 58 ); ἐ. καὶ τρίτης [ἡμέρας] ( LXX.Ruth.2.11, compare 2nd c.AD: Marcus Antoninus Imperator 10.7. (ἐχθές is commoner than χθές) in Comedy texts and LXX, is the only form used in “NT”, and frequently in papyri of all periods, ( “PSI” 4.442.21 (3rd c.BC), etc.))

G5505.def:
χιλιάς, -άδος, ἡ
(χίλιοι), [in LXX for אֶלֶף ;] 
the number one thousand, a thousand: Luc 14:31, Actes 4:4, 1 Corinthiens 10:8, Apocalypse 5:11 7:4-8 11:13 14:1, 3 21:16.†

G5506.def:
χιλίαρχος (in Hdt., al., -ης), -ου, ὁ 
(χίλιοι, ἄρχω) [in LXX chiefly for אַלּוּף שַׂר ;] 
a chiliarch, the commander of a thousand, esp. a Roman military tribune, the commander of a cohort: Jean 18:12, Actes 21:31-33, 37 22:24-29 23:10, 15 23:17-19, 22 24:7, 22 25:23; more generally, of officers of similar rank, Marc 6:21, Apocalypse 6:15 19:18 (see, DB, i, 352b; DCG, i, 271a, 307a).†

G5508.def:
χίος, -ου, ἡ 
Chios, an island in Ægean Sea: Actes 20:15.†

G5509.def:
χιτών, ῶνος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for כְּתֹנֶת:] 
the garment worn next the skin (though two tunics were sometimes worn, see Swete, Mk., 117), a tunic: Matthieu 10:10, Marc 6:9 14:63, Luc 3:11 9:3, Ju 23; dieting. from ἱμάτιον (which see), Matthieu 5:40, Luc 6:29, Jean 19:23, Actes 9:39 (see DCG, i, 338, 340, 499)

G5510.def:
χιών, -όνος, ἡ 
[in LXX chiefly for שֶׁלֶג also (in Da) for תְּלַג ;] 
snow: Matthieu 28:3, Apocalypse 1:14.†

G5511.def:
χλαμύς, -ύδος, ἡ 
[in LXX: 2Ma.12:35 * ;] 
a chlamys, or short cloak worn over the χιτών (which see): Matthieu 27:28, 31 (see Tr., Syn., § 1).†

G5512.def:
χλευάζω
(χλεύη, a jest), [in LXX: Wis.11:14, 2Ma.7:7, 4Ma.5:22 * ;] 
to jest, mock, jeer: Actes 17:32.†

G5513.def:
χλιαρός, -ά, -όν
(χλίω, to become warm), 
warm, tepid; metaphorically, of persons, luke-warm: Apocalypse 3:16.†

G5514G.def:
Χλόη, -ης, ἡ
(i.e. tender foliage), 
Chloe: 1 Corinthiens 1:11.†

G5515.def:
χλωρός, -ά, -όν
(χλόη), [in LXX for יֶרֶק, etc. ;] 
__(a) pale green: χόρτος, Marc 6:39, Apocalypse 8:7; πᾶν χ., Apocalypse 9:4; 
__(b) pale: ἵππος, Apocalypse 6:8.†

G5517.def:
χοϊκός, -ή, -όν,
(χοῦς) 
earthy, made of dust: 1 Corinthiens 15:47-49 (see Field, Notes, 179 f.).†

G5518.def:
χοῖνιξ, -ικος, ἡ 
[in LXX: Eze.45:10-11 (בַּת) * ;] 
a chænix, a dry measure of rather less than a quart: Apocalypse 6:6 (EV, measure).†

G5519.def:
χοῖρος, -ου, ὁ 
[in Sm.: Ésaïe 65:4 66:3 ;] 
a swine: pl., Matthieu 7:6 8:30-32, Marc 5:11-13, 16, Luc 8:32-33 15:15-16 †

G5520.def:
χολάω, -ῶ
(χολή), [in LXX: 3Ma.3:1 R * ;] 
__1. to be melancholy mad (Aristoph.). 
__2. = χολοῦμαι, to be angry: with dative of person(s), Jean 7:23.†

G5521.def:
χολή, -ῆς, ἡ 
[in LXX for רֹאשׁ, לַעֲנָה, מְרֵרָה ;] 
gall: Matthieu 27:34 (here prob. = myrrh, cf. Marc 15:23, see Swete, in l; DCG, i, 634); metaphorically, Actes 8:23.†

G5522.def:
χοῦς, -οός accusative, οῦν, ὁ, (contr. from χόος), 
[in LXX chiefly for עָפָר ;] 
__1. earth, soil. 
__2. In later writers (Pint., LXX), = κονιορτός, dust: Marc 6:11, Apocalypse 18:19.†

G5523.def:
Χοραζείν (Rec. -ζίν), ἡ, 
Chorazin, a town of Galilee: Matthieu 11:21, Luc 10:13.†

G5524.def:
χορηγέω, -ῶ
(χορός, ἡγέομαι) [in LXX for כּוּל pilp. ;] 
__1. to lead a χορός (see LS, see word). 
__2. to defray the cost of a χορός. 
__3. In late writers, metaphorically, with accusative (see M, Pr., 65), to supply, furnish abundantly: 2 Corinthiens 9:10, 1 Pierre 4:11 (Polyb., al.).†

G5525.def:
χορός, -οῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for מָחוֹל, מְחֹלָה ;] 
a dance: pl., Luc 15:25.†

G5526.def:
χορτάζω 
(χόρτος), [in LXX for שָׂבַע, Psaumes 17:14 al. ;] 
__(a) prop., of animals (see Lft. on Philippiens 4:12), to feed, fatten: Apocalypse 19:21; 
__(b) in late Gk. (Kennedy, Sources, 82, 156), of persons, to fill or satisfy with food: with accusative of person(s), Matthieu 15:33; pass., Matthieu 14:20 15:37, Marc 6:42 7:27 8:8, Luc 9:17, Jean 6:26, Jacques 2:16; opposite to πεινᾶν, Philippiens 4:12; with genitive of thing(s), Marc 8:4; ἀπό, Luc 16:21; ἐκ, Luc 15:16, WH, txt.; metaphorically, Matthieu 5:6, Luc 6:21.†

G5527.def:
χόρτασμα, -τος, τό
(χορτάζω), [in LXX: Genèse 24:25, 32 42:27 43:24, Juges 19:19 (מִסְפּוֹא), Deutéronome 11:16 (עֶשֶׂב), (Sir.33:24) Sir.38:26 * ;] 
fodder (Polyb., Plut., al.): pl., Actes 7:11 (RV, sustenance).†

G5528.def:
χόρτος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for עֶשֶׂב, also for חָצִיר, etc. ;] 
__1. an enclosure, a feeding place (Hom.). 
__2. food, esp. for cattle, grass: Matthieu 13:26 14:19, Marc 4:28 6:39, Luc 12:28, Jean 6:10, 1 Corinthiens 3:12, Jacques 1:10-11, 1 Pierre 1:24" (LXX), Apocalypse 9:4; χ. χλωρός, Marc 6:39, Apocalypse 8:7.†

G5530.def:
χράομαι, χρῶμαι
(χρή), [in LXX for עָשָׂה, etc. ;] 
to use, make use of: with dative (cf. M, Pr., 64, 158), Actes 27:17, 1 Corinthiens 9:12 9:15, 1 Timothée 1:8 5:23; μᾶλλον χρῆσαι (i.e. the opportunity; see M, Pr., 247), 1 Corinthiens 7:21; as some­times in late writers (cf. M, Pr., 64; Lft., Notes, 233), with accusative, 1 Corinthiens 7:31; of feelings, etc., to exercise, shew: 2 Corinthiens 1:17 3:12; with adv., ἀποτόμως, to deal sharply, 2 Corinthiens 13:10; with dative of person(s) (cl.), to treat, deal with, Actes 27:3.†

G5531.def:
χράω, κίχρημι 
[in LXX for לָוָה, etc. ;] 
to lend: Luc 11:5.†

G5532.def:
χρεία, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX: 2 Chroniques 2:16 (15) (צֹרֶךְ), Esther 7:20 (חַשְׁחוּת) frequently in Sir.1:1-30 -2 Mac ;] 
__1. need, necessity: Actes 28:10, Tite 3:14; πρὸς οἰκοδομὴν τῆς χ. (RV, txt., for edifying as the need may be; but see Field, Notes, 192), Éphésiens 4:29; ἕστι χ., Luc 10:42, Hébreux 7:11; χ. ἔχειν, with genitive, Matthieu 6:8 21:3, Marc 11:3, Luc 9:11 15:7 19:31, 34 22:71, Jean 13:29, 1 Corinthiens 12:21 12:24, 1 Thessaloniciens 4:12, Hébreux 10:36, Apocalypse 21:23 22:5; before τοῦ, with inf. (Bl., § 71, 3), Hébreux 5:12; absol. (sc. genitive), Actes 2:45 4:35; with genitive of person(s), Matthieu 9:12 26:65, Marc 2:17 14:63, Luc 5:31; with inf. (Bl., § 69, 5), Matthieu 3:14 14:16, Jean 13:10, 1 Thessaloniciens 1:8 4:9; before ἵνα, Jean 16:30, 1 Jean 2:27; absol., Marc 2:25, Éphésiens 4:28, 1 Jean 3:17; οὐδὲν χ. ἔχειν, Apocalypse 3:17; ἡ χ., with genitive subjc., Philippiens 2:25 4:16, 19; pl., Actes 20:34, Romains 12:13. 
__2. matter, business (so esp. in late writers, Polyb., al.; 1Ma.12:45, al.): Actes 6:3.†

G5533.def:
χρεοφειλέτης (Rec. χρεω-, WH, χρεοφιλ-; see WH, App., 152, 154), -ου, ὁ, 
(χρέος, a debt, + ὀφειλέτης) [in LXX: Job 31:37, Proverbes 29:13 * ;] 
a debtor: Luc 7:41 16:5.†

G5534.def:
χρή impers. 
(χράω, see LS, see word), 
it is necessary: Jacques 3:10 (cf. δεῖ.).†

G5535.def:
χρῄζω
(χρή) [in LXX Juges 11:7, 1 Rois 17:18 A * ;] 
to need, have need of: with genitive of thing(s), Matthieu 6:32, Luc 11:8 12:30, 2 Corinthiens 3:1; with genitive of person(s) before ἐν, Romains 16:2.†

G5536.def:
χρῆμα, -τος, τό
(χράομαι) [in LXX: Josué 22:8, 2 Chroniques 1:11-12 (נֶכֶס), Job 27:17 (כֶּסֶף), etc.; frequently in Sir (5:1, 8, al.), 2 and 4 Mac ;] 
a thing that one uses or needs (and generally, a matter, event, business); hence in pl., 
__(a) wealth, riches: οἱ τά χ. ἔχοντες, Marc 10:23-24, Luc 18:24; 
__(b) money: Actes 8:18, 20 24:26; sing. (rare in cl.) of a special sum of money, Actes 4:37.†

G5537.def:
χρηματίζω
(χρῆμα), [in LXX: Jérémie 26:2 29:23 30:2 36:2, 4 A (דָבַר pi.), Jérémie 25:30) (שָׁאַג), 3Ki.18:27, Job 40:8 * ;] 
__1. to transact business, hence, to consult, deliberate (Thuc., Dem., al.); hence in later writers, 
__2. to make answer (esp. of offcial pronounce­ments by magistrates, etc.; in π. of the royal reply to an ἔντευξις, which see; cf. Deiss., BS, 122); of an answer by an oracle (Died., Plut., al.); in FlJ, LXX and NT, of divine communications, to instruct, admonish, warn: pass. (Bl., § 54, 3), Matthieu 2:22, Hébreux 8:5 11:7 12:25; with inf. (Bl., § 69,4; 70, 3; 72, 5), Matthieu 2:12, Luc 2:26, Actes 10:22 
__3. to assume a name (as in business), be called (Polyb., al.): Actes 11:26, Romains 7:3 (gnomic fut.; cf. Burton, § 69).†

G5538.def:
χρηματισμός, -οῦ), ὁ
(χρηματίζω, which see), [in LXX: Proverbes 31:1 (מַשָּׂא), 2Ma.2:4 2Mac 11:17 * ;] 
a divine response, an oracle: Romains 11:4 (Xen., Plat., al.).†

G5539.def:
χρήσιμος, -η, -ον
(χράομαι), [in LXX: Genèse 37:26 בֶּצַע etc. ;] 
useful: 2 Timothée 2:14.†

G5540.def:
χρῆσις, -εως, ἡ
(χράομαι), [in LXX: 1 Rois 1:28 (שָׁאַל), Sir.18:8, al. ;] 
use: in a sexual sense, Romains 1:26; with genitive obj., θηλείας, Romains 1:27 (for exx., see Thayer, see word).†

G5542.def:
χρηστολογία, -ας, ἡ
(χρηστός, λέγω), 
fair speaking: in bad sense, Romains 16:18 (in good sense also, eccl.).†

G5544.def:
χρηστότης, -ητος, ἡ
(χρηστός), [in LXX for טוּב and cogn. forms ;] 
__1. goodness, excellence, uprightness: Romains 3:12 (LXX). 
__2. goodness of heart, kindness: Romains 2:4, 2 Corinthiens 6:6, Galates 5:22, Colossiens 3:12, Tite 3:4; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Éphésiens 2:7; id., opposite to ἀποτομία, Romains 11:22. 
SYN.: see: ἀγαθωσύνη.

G5545.def:
χρίσμα (T, χρῖσμα, as in cl.; see Tdf., Pr., 102; Bl., § 4, 2), -τος, το 
(χρίω), 
later form of χρῖμα (Æsch., al.), 
[in LXX for מִשְׁחָה and cogn. forms (Exode 29:7, al.) ;] 
an anointing, unction (the result of the action χρίειν; ICC, in l; but cf. Westc., in l, for the view that the oil, not the act, is meant): 1 Jean 2:20 Jn 2:27.†

G5546.def:
Χριστιανός (D, Χρεισ-; on the form Χρησ-, see Bl., § 3, 6; 27, 4 on the ending, -ανος, see Bl., ll. with; Deiss., LAE, 382), -οῦ ὁ, 
a Christian, the name first given to the disciples by pagan gentiles at Antioch: Actes 11:26 26:28, 1 Pierre 4:16 (see reff. in Thayer, see word; also DB, i, 384).†

G5547.def:
χριστός (Χρ-), -ή, -όν 
(χρίω), [in LXX for מָשִׁיחַ and cogn. forms ;] 
__1. 1. as adj., 
__(a) of things, anointing, to be used as ointment (Æsch., Eur., al.; τ. ἔλαιον τὸ χ., Lévitique 21:10); 
__(b) of persons, anointed (ὁ ἰερεὺς ὁ χ., Lévitique 4:5; οἱ χ. ἰευρεῖς, 2Ma.1:10): ὁ χ. τοῦ κυρίου or Θεοῦ (1 Rois 2:10, Psaumes 2:2, al.), of the Messiah (Aram., מְשִׁיחָא; cf. Dalman, Words, 289 ff.), Luc 2:11, 26 Jean 1:41, Actes 2:36 4:26, al. 
__2. As subst., ὁ Χριστός, the Messiah, the Christ: Matthieu 2:4, Marc 8:29, Luc 2:11, Jean 1:20, Actes 2:31, Romains 7:4, al.; Ἰησοῦς, Marc 1:1, Jean 1:17, Actes 2:38, al.; Χ. Ἰησοῦς, Matthieu 1:18, WH, mg. Actes 5:42, Romains 6:3, al.; Χ. κύριος, Luc 2:11; Ἰησοῦς Χ. ὁ κύριος, Actes 15:26, Romains 1:7, al.

G5548.def:
χρίω 
to anoint (Hom., al.); 
[in LXX chiefly for מָשַׁח of consecration to a sacred office: priest, Exode 28:41; prophet, 3Ki.19:16; king, 1 Rois 10:1; of things, Exode 40:9, Lévitique 8:10, al.]. 
In NT, metaphorically, of God's anointing, 
__(a) Christ: Actes 4:27; with inf., Luc 4:18 (LXX); with dupl. accusative (see B1., § 34, 4), Hébreux 1:9 (LXX); πνεύματι ἁγίῳ, Actes 10:38; 
__(b) Christians: 2 Corinthiens 1:21 (cf. Westc., Epp. Jo., 73) (cf. ἐν-, ἐπι-Χριω).†
SYN: see: ἀλείφω

G5549.def:
χρονίζω
(χρόνος), [in LXX chiefly for אָחַר pi. ;] 
to spend or take time, to tarry, linger, delay: Matthieu 24:48 25:5, Hébreux 10:37; before ἐν, with dative loc., Luc 1:21; with inf., Luc 12:45.†

G5550.def:
χρόνος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for יוֹם, also for עֵת, etc. ;] 
time (a space of time, whether long or short; cf. Lft., Notes, 70): Matthieu 2:7, Marc 9:21, Luc 1:57, Actes 3:21 7:17, 23 13:18 17:30 27:9, Hébreux 11:32, 1 Pierre 1:17 4:3, Apocalypse 10:6; στιγμὴ χρόνου, Luc 4:5; πλήρωμα τοῦ χ., Galates 4:4; ποιεῖν χ., Actes 15:33 18:23; βιῶσαι, 1 Pierre 4:2; διδόναι, Apocalypse 2:21; pl., χ. καὶ (ἢ) καιροί (Lft., l.with), Actes 1:7, 1 Thessaloniciens 5:1; ἐπ᾽ ἐσχάτου τῶν χ. (χρόνου), 1 Pierre 1:20, Ju 18; with prep., ἄχρι, Actes 3:21; διὰ τὸν χ., Hébreux 5:12; ἐν χ., Actes 1:6, 21; ἐπὶ (πλείονα) χ., Luc 18:4, Actes 18:20; ἐφ᾽ ὅσον χ., Romains 7:1, 1 Corinthiens 7:39, Galates 4:1; κατὰ τὸν χ., Matthieu 2:16; μετὰ τολὺν (τοσοῦτον) χ., Matthieu 25:19, Hébreux 4:7; πρὸ χ. αἰωςίων, 2 Timothée 1:9, Tite 1:2, instr. dative of extension of time (see M, Pr., 75, 148; Deiss., LAE, 206), Luc 8:27, 29 Jean 14:9, Actes 8:11, Romains 16:25; accusative, of duration of time, Marc 2:19, Luc 20:9, Jean 5:6 7:33 12:35 14:9, Actes 14:3, 28 19:22 20:18, 1 Corinthiens 16:7, Apocalypse 6:11.†
SYN.: see: καιρός

G5551.def:
χρονοτριβέω, -ῶ
(χρόνος, τρίβω), 
to spend time: Actes 20:16.†

G5552.def:
Χρύσεος, -εα, -εον (-οῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν; on accusative sing. fem., -ᾶν, Apocalypse 1:13 and genitive pl. uncontr., -εων, Apocalypse 2:1, LTr., see M, Pr., 48 and cf. Thackeray, Gr., x, 172 f.)
(χρυσός), [in LXX chiefly for זָהָב ;] 
golden, i.e. made or overlaid with gold: 2 Timothée 2:20, Hébreux 9:4, Apocalypse 1:12-13, 20 2:1 4:4 5:8 8:3 9:13, 20 14:14 15:6-7 17:4 21:15.†

G5553.def:
χρυσίον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of χρυσός, which see), [in LXX chiefly for זָהָב ;] 
a piece of gold, gold: 1 Corinthiens 3:12, Hébreux 9:4, 1 Pierre 1:7, Apocalypse 3:18 21:18, 21; of golden ornaments, 1 Timothée 2:9 (WH, txt., RV), 1 Pierre 3:3, Apocalypse 17:4 18:16 (WH, txt., R); of gold coin, money, Actes 3:6 20:33, 1 Pierre 1:18.†

G5554.def:
χρυσο-δακτύλιος, -ον 
with a gold ring: Jacques 2:2.†

G5555.def:
χρυσό-λιθος, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Exode 28:20 36:20 (Exode 39:13), Eze.28:13 (תַּרְשִׁישׁ) * ;] 
a chrysolite (on its identification, see Swete, Ap., 288 f.; DB, iv, 620): Apocalypse 21:20.†

G5556.def:
χρυσό-πρασος, -ου, ὁ 
a chrysoprase (see Swete, Ap., 289): Apocalypse 21:20.†

G5557.def:
χρυσός, -οῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for זָהָב ;] 
gold: Matthieu 2:11, Apocalypse 9:7; of golden ornaments, Matthieu 23:16-17, 1 Timothée 2:9 (Rec., WH, mg.), Jacques 5:3, Apocalypse 17:4 (Rec., WH, mg.) Apocalypse 18:12, 16 (Rec., WH, mg.); of images, Actes 17:29; of gold coin, Matthieu 10:9.†

G5558.def:
χρυσόω, -ῶ
(χρυσός) [in LXX chiefly for צָפָה pi. ;] 
to gild, cover with gold: pass., with dative, χρυσίῳ (pleonast., cf. Exode 26:37), Apocalypse 17:4 18:16.†

G5559.def:
χρώς, genitive, χρωτός, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for בָּשָׂר ;] 
in cl. rare in prose, the surface of the body, skin: Actes 19:12.†

G5560.def:
χωλός, -ή, -όν 
[in LXX for פִּסֵּחַ ;] 
lame, halt, maimed: Matthieu 11:5 15:30-31 18:8 21:14, Marc 9:45, Luc 7:22 14:13, 21, Jean 5:3, Actes 3:2 8:7 14:8, Hébreux 12:13.†

G5561.def:
χώρα, -ας, ἡ 
[in LXX for אֶרֶץ, מְדִינָה, etc. ;] 
__1. most frequently in cl., a space, place. 
__2. land, i.e. 
__(a) a land, country, region: Matthieu 12:2, Marc 5:10 6:55, Luc 2:8 15:13-15 19:12, Jean 11:54, Actes 13:49 27:27; χ. Γαλατική, Actes 16:6 18:23; Τραχωνίτιδος, Luc 3:1; τ. Ἰουδαίας, Actes 26:20; τ. Ἰουδαίων, Actes 10:39; pl., τῆς Ἰουδαίας κ. Σαμαρείας, Actes 8:1; Γεργεσηνῶν (Γερασηνῶν, Γαδαρηνῶν) Matthieu 8:28, Marc 5:1, Luc 8:26; ἐν χ. καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου, Matthieu 4:16; 
__(b) land, property: Luc 12:16; 
__(with) the country, opposite to the town; so in pl., Luc 21:21, Jean 4:35, Jacques 5:4.†
SYN.: ἄγρος, τόπος (cf. DCG, i, 591a; LS, see word χώρα, ad init.).

G5562.def:
χωρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Genèse 13:6 (נָשָׂא), 3Ki.7:26 7:38 (כּוּל hi.), 2 Chroniques 4:5 (חָזַק hi.), Wis.7:23-24, al. ;] 
__I. Intrans., 
__1. to make room, give way, retire, pass: before εἰς, Matthieu 15:17; metaphorically (EV, come), εἰς μετάνοιαν, 2 Pierre 3:9. 
__2. to go forward, advance, progress (Plat., Polyb., al.) ὁ λόγος ὁ ἐμὸς οὐ χωρεῖ. ἐν ὑμῖν, Jean 8:37 (R, txt., hath not free course; R, mg., hath no place, for WH. cf. Field, Notes, 94 f.). 
__II. Trans., to have space for holding, to hold: Marc 2:2 (cf. Ge, l.with), Jean 21:25; of measures (1Ki, 2Ch, ll. with), Jean 2:6. Metaphorical, of having or making room in mind or heart: Matthieu 19:11-12 (EV, receive), 2 Corinthiens 7:2 (R, txt., open your hearts; mg., make room) (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ὑπο-χωρέω).†

G5563.def:
χωρίζω 
[in LXX: 2 Chroniques 12:8, al. (בָּדַל ni., etc.), Wis.1:3, 2Ma.5:21, al. ;] 
__1. to separate, divide, put asunder: with accusative of thing(s), opposite to συζεύγνυμι Matthieu 19:6, Marc 10:9; with accusative of person(s), before ἀπό (Wis.1:3), Romains 8:35, 39; pf. pass ptcp., Hébreux 7:26. 
__2. In late writers, mid. and 1 aor pass., to separate oneself, depart: Phm 15; before ἀπό Actes 1:4, ἐκ, Actes 18:1-2; of divorce (polyb., al.), 1 Corinthiens 7:10-11 7:15 (cf. ἀπο-, δια-χωρίζω).†

G5564G.def:
χωρίον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of χώρα, χῶρος), [in LXX: 1 Chroniques 27:27 (כֶּרֶם), 2Ma.11:5 2Mac 12:7 2Mac 12:21, 4Ma.15:20 * ;] 
__1. a place, region. 
__2. an estate, property, piece of land: Matthieu 26:36, Marc 14:32, Jean 4:5, Actes 1:18-19 4:34 5:3, 8 28:7.†

G5564H.def:
χωρίον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of χώρα, χῶρος), [in LXX: 1 Chroniques 27:27 (כֶּרֶם), 2Ma.11:5 2Mac 12:7 2Mac 12:21, 4Ma.15:20 * ;] 
__1. a place, region. 
__2. an estate, property, piece of land: Matthieu 26:36, Marc 14:32, Jean 4:5, Actes 1:18-19 4:34 5:3, 8 28:7.†

G5565.def:
χωρίς 
adv., 
__1. separately, apart: Jean 20:7. 
__2. As prep., with genitive, 
__(a) separate from, apart from, without (practically equiv. to ἄνευ; see Field, Notes, 103): Matthieu 13:34, Marc 4:34, Luc 6:49, Jean 1:3 15:5, Romains 3:21, 28 4:6 7:8-9 10:14, 1 Corinthiens 4:8 11:11, 2 Corinthiens 12:3, Éphésiens 2:12, Philippiens 2:14, 1 Timothée 2:8 5:21, Phm 14, Hébreux 4:15 7:7, 20 9:7, 18 9:22, 28 10:25 11:6, 40 12:8, 14 (οὗ χωρίς; see Bl., § 82, 3), Jacques 2:18, 20 2:26; 
__(b) besides: Matthieu 14:21 15:38, 2 Corinthiens 11:28.†

G5566.def: the North-west wind , Lat. Caurus, (New Testament) (ML)

G5567.def:
ψάλλω 
[in LXX chiefly for זָמַר pi. (Juges 5:3, Psaumes 7:17, al.), also for נָגַן pi. (1 Rois 16:16 ff, al.) ;] 
__1. to pull, twitch, twang (as a bowstring, etc.; Æsch., Eur., al.), hence, 
__2. absol., 
__(a) to play a stringed instrument with the fingers (Hdt., Plat., al.); 
__(b) later, to sing to a harp, sing psalms (LXX); in NT, to sing a hymn, sing praise: Jacques 5:13; with dative of person(s), Romains 15:9 (LXX), Éphésiens 5:19; dative instr., 1 Corinthiens 14:15.†

G5568.def:
ψαλμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ψάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מִזְמוֹר ;] 
__1. a striking, twitching with the fingers (Eur., al.), hence, a striking of musical strings (Æsch., a1.), and hence in later writers, 
__2. a sacred song sung to musical accompaniment, a psalm (LXX): 1 Corinthiens 14:26, Éphésiens 5:19, Colossiens 3:16; of OT psalms, Luc 24:44, Actes 13:33; βίβλος ψαλμῶν, Luc 20:42, Actes 1:20.†
SYN.: see: ὕμνος

G5569.def:
ψευδ-άδελφος, -ου, ὁ 
a false brother: of professing Christians, 2 Corinthiens 11:26, Galates 2:4.†

G5570.def:
ψευδ-απόστολος, -ου, ὁ 
a false apostle: 2 Corinthiens 11:13.†

G5571.def:
ψευδής, -ές
(ψεύδομαι), [in LXX for שֶׁקֶר, שָׁוְא, כָּזָב; etc. ;] 
lying, false, untrue (of persons and things): Apocalypse 2:2; μάρτυρες, Actes 6:13; as subst., ὁ ψ., a liar: Apocalypse 21:8.†

G5572.def:
ψευδο-διδάσκαλος, -ου, ὁ 
a false teacher: 2 Pierre 2:1.†

G5573.def:
ψευδο-λόγος, -ον
(ψευδής, λέγω), 
speaking falsely, lying: 1 Timothée 4:2 (Aristoph., Polyb., al.).†

G5574.def:
ψεύδω to deceive by lies; more frequently in the depon. mid, form ψεύδομαι (so always in NT), 
[in LXX chiefly for כָּחַשׁ pi. ;] 
__1. absol., to lie: Hébreux 6:18, 1 Jean 1:6, Apocalypse 3:9; οὐ ψεύδομαι, Romains 9:1, 2 Corinthiens 11:31, Galates 1:20, 1 Timothée 2:7 with dative of person(s) (Psaumes 18:45, Jean 5:12, al.), Actes 5:4; before εἰς, Colossiens 3:9; κατά, Jacques 3:14 (Hort, in l). 
__2. Like act., with accusative, to deceive by lies (Æsch., al.): Actes 5:3.†

G5575.def:
ψευδο-μάρτυς, -υρος, ὁ 
[in LXX: Dan LXX Su 1:60-61 Bl * ;] 
a false witness: Matthieu 26:60; with genitive obj. (see WM, § 30, 1a), 1 Corinthiens 15:15.†

G5576.def:
ψευδο-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX: Exode 20:16, Deutéronome 5:20 (17) (עָנָה), Da TH Su 1:61 AB2R (see ψευδομάρτυς) * ;] 
to bear false witness: Matthieu 19:18, Marc 10:19, Luc 18:20" (LXX) ; before κατά, with genitive of person(s), Marc 14:56-57 (Xen., Plat., al.).†

G5578.def:
ψευδο-προφήτης, -ου, ὁ 
[in LXX: Zacharie 13:2, Jérémie 1:9 (Jérémie 6:13, al.) (נָבִיא)* ;] 
a false prophet (= cl. ψευδόμαντις): Matthieu 7:15 24:11, 24, Marc 13:22 (see Swete, in l), Luc 6:26, Actes 13:6, 2 Pierre 2:1, 1 Jean 4:1, Apocalypse 16:13 19:20 20:10 †

G5579.def:
ψεῦδος, -εος (-ους), τό 
[in LXX chiefly for שֶׁקֶר, also for כַּחַשׁ, כָּזָב ;] 
a falsehood, untruth, lie: Apocalypse 14:15; opposite to ἡ ἀλήθεια, Jean 8:44, Romains 1:25, Éphésiens 4:25, 2 Thessaloniciens 2:11, 1 Jean 2:21; to τὸ ἀληθές, 1 Jean 2:27; ποιεῖν ψ., Apocalypse 21:27 22:15; ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει κ. σημείοις κ. τέρασιν ψεύδους (genitive qual., see M, Th., 104; and on the meaning and construction, see also ICC, in l), 2 Thessaloniciens 2:9.†

G5580.def:
ψευδό-χριστος, -ου ὁ 
a false Christ or Messiah, "a pretender to the Messianic office" (Swete, Mk., 309; cf. also Tr., Syn., § xxx): Matthieu 24:24, Marc 13:22 (cf. ἀντίχριστος).†

G5581.def:
ψευδώνυμος, -ον
(ψευδής, ὄνομα) 
under a false name, falsely called: 1 Timothée 6:20 (Æsch., Plut., a1.).†

G5582.def:
ψεῦσμα, -τος, τό
(ψεύδω), [in Aq., Th.: Job 34:6, Proverbes 23:3; in Sm.: Job 13:4, al. ;] 
a lie, falsehood: Romains 3:7 (Plat., Plut. al.).†

G5583.def:
ψεύστης, -ου, ὁ
(ψεύδω), [in LXX: Psaumes 116:11 (כָּזַב), Proverbes 19:22 A N2 (כָּזָב), Sir.15:8 25:2 * ;] 
a liar: Jean 8:44, 55, Romains 3:4, 1 Timothée 1:10, Tite 1:12, 1 Jean 1:10 Jn 2:4 Jn 2:22 Jn 4:20 Jn 5:10 .†

G5584.def:
ψηλαφάω, -ῶ
(ψάω, to touch), [in LXX for מוּשׁ, מָשַׁשׁ pi., etc. ;] 
__1. to feel or grope about; with accusative, to feel about for, search after: metaphorically, of seeking God, Actes 17:27. 
__2. to feel, touch, handle: with accusative of person(s), Luc 24:39, 1 Jean 1:1; προσεληλύθατε ψηλαφωμένῳ (ὄρει ?), Hébreux 12:18 (R, txt., a mount that might be touched; mg., a palpable and kindled fire; see Westc., in l).†

G5585.def:
ψηφίζω
(ψῆφος), [in LXX: 3Ki.3:8 8:5 A (סָפַר ni..) * ;] 
to count (prop., with pebbles), reckon, calculate: τ. δαπάνην, Luc 14:28; τ. ἀριθμόν (i.e. calculate the number's meaning), Apocalypse 13:18 (in cl. chiefly mid., to vote by casting a pebble; cf. συγ-κατα-, συμ-φηφίζω).†

G5586G.def:
ψῆφος, -ου, ἡ
(ψάω, to rub) [in LXX: Exode 4:25 (צֹר), La 3:16 (חָצָץ), Ecclésiaste 7:26 (25) (צֹר), 4Ki.12:4 (5) A, Sir.18:10, 4Ma.15:26 * ;] 
__1. a small smooth stone, a pebble: ψ. λευκή (for suggestions as to the meaning, see Swete, in l), Apocalypse 2:17. 
__2. From the use of pebbles in voting, a vote: Actes 26:10.†

G5586H.def:
ψῆφος, -ου, ἡ
(ψάω, to rub) [in LXX: Exode 4:25 (צֹר), La 3:16 (חָצָץ), Ecclésiaste 7:26 (25) (צֹר), 4Ki.12:4 (5) A, Sir.18:10, 4Ma.15:26 * ;] 
__1. a small smooth stone, a pebble: ψ. λευκή (for suggestions as to the meaning, see Swete, in l), Apocalypse 2:17. 
__2. From the use of pebbles in voting, a vote: Actes 26:10.†

G5588.def:
ψιθυριστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(see supr.), 
a whisperer (as epithet of Hermes, Dem., 1358, 6): in bad sense, Romains 1:30.†
Syn.: καταλάλος, q.v

G5589.def:
ψιχίον, -ου, τό 
dimin. of ψίξ, 
a crumb: Matthieu 15:27, Marc 7:28.†

G5590G.def:
ψυχή, -ῆς, ἡ, 
[in LXX very frequently for נֶפֶשׁ, sometimes for לֵבַב ,לֵב, etc. ;] 
__1. breath (Lat. anima), breath of life, life (Hom., al.; in Arist., of the vital principle): Matthieu 6:25, Marc 3:4 10:45, Luc 12:22, Jean 10:11, Actes 20:10, 24 2 Corinthiens 1:23, Philippiens 2:30, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:8, al. 
__2. the soul, 
__(a) as the seat of the will, desires and affections: Matthieu 26:38, Marc 12:30" (LXX) 14:34, Luc 1:46, Jean 10:24, Actes 14:2, Philippiens 1:27, al.; ἐκ ψυχῆς, from the heart, heartily: Éphésiens 6:6, Colossiens 3:23; 
__(b) as a periphrasis for person or self (frequently in translation from Semitic originals, see M, Pr., 87; Robinson, Gospels, 113ff.; but also frequently in cl., see LS, see word II, 2; Edwards, Lex., App. A.): Matthieu 11:29, Marc 8:36, Actes 2:41, Romains 2:9, 1 Pierre 3:20, al.; πᾶσα ψ., Actes 2:43 3:23" (LXX), Romains 13:1; ψ. ζῶσα (ζωῆς), 1 Corinthiens 15:45, Apocalypse 16:3; 
__(with) as the object of divine grace and eternal salvation: Hébreux 13:17, Jacques 1:21 5:20, 1 Pierre 1:9, 22 2:11 4:19, 3Jo.2. 
SYN.: see: νοῦς, πνεῦμα, ψυχικός, and cf. ICC on 1 Thessaloniciens 5:23, Lft., Notes, 88f.

G5590H.def:
ψυχή, -ῆς, ἡ, 
[in LXX very frequently for נֶפֶשׁ, sometimes for לֵבַב ,לֵב, etc. ;] 
__1. breath (Lat. anima), breath of life, life (Hom., al.; in Arist., of the vital principle): Matthieu 6:25, Marc 3:4 10:45, Luc 12:22, Jean 10:11, Actes 20:10, 24 2 Corinthiens 1:23, Philippiens 2:30, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:8, al. 
__2. the soul, 
__(a) as the seat of the will, desires and affections: Matthieu 26:38, Marc 12:30" (LXX) 14:34, Luc 1:46, Jean 10:24, Actes 14:2, Philippiens 1:27, al.; ἐκ ψυχῆς, from the heart, heartily: Éphésiens 6:6, Colossiens 3:23; 
__(b) as a periphrasis for person or self (frequently in translation from Semitic originals, see M, Pr., 87; Robinson, Gospels, 113ff.; but also frequently in cl., see LS, see word II, 2; Edwards, Lex., App. A.): Matthieu 11:29, Marc 8:36, Actes 2:41, Romains 2:9, 1 Pierre 3:20, al.; πᾶσα ψ., Actes 2:43 3:23" (LXX), Romains 13:1; ψ. ζῶσα (ζωῆς), 1 Corinthiens 15:45, Apocalypse 16:3; 
__(with) as the object of divine grace and eternal salvation: Hébreux 13:17, Jacques 1:21 5:20, 1 Pierre 1:9, 22 2:11 4:19, 3Jo.2. 
SYN.: see: νοῦς, πνεῦμα, ψυχικός, and cf. ICC on 1 Thessaloniciens 5:23, Lft., Notes, 88f.

ψυχή, -ῆς, ἡ, 
[in LXX very frequently for נֶפֶשׁ, sometimes for לֵבַב ,לֵב, etc. ;] 
__1. breath (Lat. anima), breath of life, life (Hom., al.; in Arist., of the vital principle): Matthieu 6:25, Marc 3:4 10:45, Luc 12:22, Jean 10:11, Actes 20:10, 24 2 Corinthiens 1:23, Philippiens 2:30, 1 Thessaloniciens 2:8, al.

G5591.def:
ψυχικός, -ή, -όν
(ψυχή) [in LXX: 4Ma.1:32 * ;] 
of the ψυχή (as the lower part of the immaterial in man), EV, natural: opposite to πνευματικός, 1 Corinthiens 2:14 15:44 15:46; πνεῦμα μὴ ἔχοντες (EV, sensual; R, mg., natural or animal; better perhaps, of the mind; see infr.), Ju 19; with ἐπίγειος, δαιμονιώδης, opposite to ἄνωθεν κατερχομένη (σοψία), of the mind (Hort, in l), Jacques 3:15†

G5592.def:
ψύχος (LT, ψῦ-, as in cl.), -εος (-ους), τό 
(ψύχω), [in LXX: Genèse 8:22 (קֹר), Job 37:9, Psaumes 147:17 (קָרָה), Zacharie 14:6, Dan LXX TH 3:67,69 * ;] 
cold: Jean 18:18, Actes 28:2, 2 Corinthiens 11:27.†

G5593.def:
ψυχρός, -ά, -όν
(ψύχω), [in LXX: Proverbes 25:25 (קַר), Sir.43:20, 4Ma.11:26 * ;] 
cold: sc. ὕδωρ (cf. Theogn., 263; Hdt., ii, 37), Matthieu 10:42; metaphorically, of indifferent persons, Apocalypse 3:15-16 †

G5594.def:
ψύχω 
[in LXX for קוּר, שָׁטַח ;] 
to breathe, blow; hence, to make cool. Pass., to grow cool: metaphorically, Matthieu 24:12.†

G5595.def:
ψωμίζω
(ψωμός, a morsel), [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל hi. ;] 
to feed with morsels (as children or the sick; Hippocr.), hence, generally, in late writers, to feed, nourish: with accusative of person(s), Romains 12:20 (LXX); with accusative of thing(s), to give out for food, 1 Corinthiens 13:3 (cf. WM, § 32, 4an; for dupl. accusative, cf. Nombres 11:4, Sir.15:3, al.).†

G5596.def:
ψωμίον, -ου, τό 
dimin. of ψωμός, a fragment, morsel: Jean 13:26-27, 30.†

G5597.def:
ψώχω
(ψώω, collat. form of ψάω, to rub) 
to rub: Luc 6:1.†

G5598.def:
Ω, ω, ὦ μέγα (cf. ὂ μικρόν), 
omega, ô, the twenty-fourth and last letter. As a numeral, ω᾽ = 800, ω, = 800,000. As a symbol of the last (= τὸ τέλος), τὸ Ὦ (Rec. Ω, L, ὦ, T, ω), the Omega: Apocalypse 1:8 21:6 22:13 (cf. Ἄλφα).†
